SMALL BATCHES. MEMORABLE MOMENTS.

GOOD TO KNOW

Cookies for a crowd,
planned together.

Every cookie is baked to order in small batches, so a little notice goes a long way.

Up to 3 dozen

Order online in boxes of 4, 6, 12, 24 or 36 cookies: $38 a dozen, $114 for 3 dozen, mixing any flavors on the menu. You pay through Venmo or Cash App with your order number.

Build your box

More than 3 dozen

Larger orders are arranged by inquiry, in whole dozens. Pasha confirms flavors, pricing and availability for your date by email.

Send an inquiry

Lead time

Every order needs at least one week’s notice. For large orders or busy dates like Eid and the holidays, get in touch as early as you can for the best chance of getting your date.

Flavors

Choose from four signature flavors plus the monthly specials available for your pickup date. All ingredients are halal.

See the menu

Gift notes & packaging

Have a gift note, packaging idea or theme in mind? Mention it in your inquiry or order notes and Pasha will let you know what’s possible.

Pickup

Pickup only in Tyngsboro, MA, normally between 10am and 7pm (Eastern). Delivery and shipping are not offered.

How a large-order quote works

  1. 1

    Send an inquiry with your date, rough quantity and the flavors you love.

  2. 2

    Pasha replies by email to confirm availability, flavors and pricing.

  3. 3

    Confirm with Pasha, pay as agreed, then pick up your cookies in Tyngsboro.
